Monkeypatch the network call to return our fake data monkeypatch.setattr( HitRecordIE, "_download_json", lambda self, url, video_id: fake_video, ) extractor = HitRecordIE() result = extractor._real_extract("https://hitrecord.org/records/9999999") # Only the valid string tag should be present assert result["tags"] == ["fun"] # Verify other fields are correctly parsed assert result["id"] == "9999999" assert result["url"] == "https://example.com/video.mp4" assert result["title"] == "Test Video" assert result["description"] == "Desc" assert result["duration"] == 120.0 assert result["timestamp"] == 1609459200 assert result["uploader"] == "tester" assert result["uploader_id"] == "42" assert result["view_count"] == 100 assert result["like_count"] == 10 assert result["comment_count"] == 5 def test_missing_optional_fields(monkeypatch): """Ensure that missing optional fields are handled gracefully.""" # Fake JSON with minimal required fields and missing optional ones fake_video = { "title": "Minimal", "source_url": {"mp4_url": "https://example.com/minimal.mp4"}, "body": None, "duration": None, "created_at_i": None, "user": {"username": None, "id": None}, "total_views_count": None, "hearts_count": None, "comments_count": None, "tags": None, } monkeypatch.setattr( HitRecordIE, "_download_json", lambda self, url, video_id: fake_video, ) extractor = HitRecordIE() result = extractor._real_extract("https://hitrecord.org/records/1") # Optional fields should be None or empty assert result["tags"] is None assert result["description"] == "" assert result["duration"] is None assert result["timestamp"] is None assert result["uploader"] is None assert result["uploader_id"] is None assert result["view_count"] is None assert result["like_count"] is None assert result["comment_count"] is None ```
